'''Colonel Hansen''' (Japanese: '''ハンゾウ''' ''Hanzō'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|AG}}. He appeared in ''[[AG044|The Princess and the Togepi]]'' and ''[[AG045|A Togepi Mirage!]]''. He is a crooked [[Mirage Kingdom]] official who seeks to take over the kingdom by force.

==History==
Hansen enlisted the help of {{TRT}} to kidnap {{TP|Misty|Togepi}} from {{an|Misty}}. After he was crowned and sent the [[King and Queen of the Mirage Kingdom|king and queen]] to the dungeon, Hansen relieved Team Rocket of their duties and sent them blasting off. Due to his impure heart, Hansen's rule over the Mirage Kingdom began to destroy the [[Togepi Paradise]].

In response to this, {{Ash}}, Misty, {{an|May}}, [[Max]], {{an|Brock}}, {{ho|Miranda}}, and [[Princess Sara]] fought back against him with Togepi, who by that point had evolved into Togetic; the group was covertly assisted by Team Rocket, who was vengeful from their betrayal. Even with the help of his Pokémon, Hansen ended up losing to the group, after which he was dethroned and put into the dungeon for his crime of high treason.
